# Print nethist objects

Prints the estimated probability matrix and model summary for `nethist`,
`multinethist`, and `hnethist` objects.

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'nethist'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'multinethist'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'hnethist'
print(x, ...)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  a `nethist`, `multinethist`, or `hnethist` object.

- ...:

  additional arguments passed to
  [`print()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/print.html).

## Value

The input object, invisibly.

## Examples

``` r
# \donttest{
set.seed(42)
data(polblog)
fit <- suppressMessages(nethist(polblog))
print(fit)
```
